title: Dragon's Crest
description: This project adds a new level of gear to the game called Dragoncrest, a dragonstone is combined with netherite to upgrade!
body:
This mod adds a **new kind of level** to the game, though simple to get, it is quite _overpowered_ when you think about it... 
To get to this level, you need a dragonstone, or alot of dragonstones, to then make a smithing template. With that template you combine it with a dragonstone and most netherite gear to get the upgraded armor and gear!

**Current Gear** - 
Netherite Chestplate -> Dragoncrest Chestplate
Netherite Helmet -> Dragoncrest Helmet
Netherite Boots -> Dragoncrest Boots
Netherite Leggings -> Dragoncrest Leggings
Netherite Sword -> Dragoncrest Blade
Netherite Pickaxe -> Dragoncrest Hammer

Bookshelf -> Shelf of Dragon Tomes (x5 enchantment power)
